'''Orbital station three''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. [[Autopilot/Legends|Automated]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] were used to transport visitors from orbital station three to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]].
